name: Hydrocortisone
description: Synthetic cortisol, approved for adrenal insufficiency replacement and for inflammatory conditions. At replacement dose it substitutes for endogenous adrenal output; above that it acts pharmacologically.

systems.note: Replaces the cortisol output of the HPA axis; the labelled replacement indication.
Anti-inflammatory glucocorticoid action at supraphysiological dose.
Bone density loss and muscle catabolism at supraphysiological exposure.
Mineralocorticoid activity drives sodium retention and potassium loss.

monitors.why: The hormone being replaced; the direct index of adequacy.
Localises the axis lesion and reads the adequacy of replacement.
